Before buying a second-hand watch, ensure your watch's reference number matches with your watch, and secondly ensure your movement has been used by the manufacturer for your reference number. These two checks are not enough but are the main points of a verification..

At Mainspring, we make all the required and detailed inspections before we buy a watch to display in our store and present to our customers. 
We issue a store authenticity liability certificate with each watch we sell and also provide 3 months warranty.

Eight days. One wind. 🇨🇭

The IWC Portofino Manual Winding Eight Days – Ref. IW510102 pairs classic Schaffhausen elegance with some serious mechanical engineering.

At its heart is IWC’s manufacture Calibre 59210, a hand-wound movement delivering an impressive 192-hour / 8-day power reserve. The beautifully balanced dial features a power-reserve indicator, small seconds and date display, all housed in a substantial 45mm stainless-steel case.

A refined dress watch with a movement worthy of being seen through its sapphire caseback.

⌚ IWC Portofino Hand-Wound Eight Days
Reference: IW510102
⚙️ IWC Calibre 59210 • Manual winding
🔋 8-Day / 192-Hour Power Reserve
📏 45mm Stainless Steel

A little piece of 1970s Swiss charm. ✨⌚️

De-Coven Genève — circa 1970s - New Old Stock
A distinctive vintage Swiss manual-wind watch featuring a warm gold-tone dial, bold cushion-shaped case, red enamel-style detailing and decorative crystal accents. The dial is marked “Incabloc,” referring to the shock-protection system commonly used in Swiss mechanical movements.

🇨🇭 Swiss Made
⚙️ Manual winding
🕰️ Circa 1970s
✨ Never worn / NOS condition
🤍 De-Coven Genève signed strap
